audit.whatIsWrong: The chart gives Volibear all seven rows. The mirror audit (sejuani__volibear) resolved the same chart as Sejuani taking Level 3, Level 6, First item and 2+ items, with Level 2 and 4-5 even. packet.levelChart is a third answer again (Skill at Level 1, Volibear for the other six).
audit.why: Three sources disagree and the two directions cannot both ship. I did not touch the chart rather than guess at a seven-row flip on a 50.46% lane — a wrong chart is worse than a stale one.

audit.whatIsWrong: No spike carried a real cooldown number, so 'respect her R' had nothing behind it.
audit.why: Glacial Prison is 120/105/90s. Once thrown, Sejuani has no long-range lockdown for two minutes at rank 1 — that is the biggest free window in the matchup.
audit.corrected: Rewrote spikes[1] around the 120s bola, and early around Arctic Assault's 18s rank-1 cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: Permafrost was written as a plain stun to bait, and nothing mentioned Fury of the North.
audit.why: Permafrost is a 1.5s cooldown that only stuns a target at maximum Frost stacks — Frost is applied by Winter's Wrath and her attacks, so it is the stack count, not the cooldown, that gates her stun. Separately, Frost Armor grants slow immunity, which blanks the slows on Sky Splitter and Stormbringer while it is up.
audit.corrected: Permafrost gated on max Frost stacks (break off before the last stack); Frost Armor's slow immunity stated.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Relentless Storm' appeared twice; several strings called Sejuani 'him'/'his'.
audit.why: Riot's passive name is The Relentless Storm, and Sejuani is female.
audit.corrected: Both fixed in place at equal length.

edits.before: - Sejuani Permafrost: matchup-defining — Her stun after Frost stacks. Don't get stacked + stunned. Track it before every engage.
edits.after: - Sejuani Permafrost: a 1.5s cooldown, but it only stuns at full Frost stacks — break off after two Winter's Wrath hits and it fizzles.

edits.before: Her stun after Frost stacks. Don't get stacked + stunned. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: It needs max Frost stacks, applied by her W and autos — step out at three stacks and she has no stun.

edits.before: Bully him early — stun-engage on the Permafrost cooldown and out-bite the brawl. Volibear wins by trading around Sejuani's Permafrost and cashing the pattern: stun-engage on the Permafrost cooldown and out-bite the brawl.
edits.after: Bully her early — stun-engage before Frost stacks cap and out-bite the brawl. Volibear wins by trading around Sejuani's Permafrost and cashing the pattern: stun-engage on the Permafrost cooldown and out-bite the brawl.

edits.before: Bully him early — stun-engage on the Permafrost cooldown and out-bite the brawl.
edits.after: Bully her early — stun-engage before Frost stacks cap and out-bite the brawl.

edits.before: Charge into his Permafrost. Trade without the W mark. Dive without R up. Stormbringer disables towers — your dive at 6 is the hardest punish in the lane, don't waste it on chip damage.
edits.after: Charge into her Permafrost. Trade without the W mark. Dive without R up. Stormbringer disables towers — your dive at 6 is the hardest punish in the lane, don't waste it on chip damage.

edits.before: Level 1-2 is a light skill read but tilts your way fast: Sejuani wants to farm and Frost-stack while you soak Relentless Storm, and her tank kit has no early burst to punish you.
edits.after: Level 1-2 is a light skill read but tilts your way fast: Sejuani farms and Frost-stacks while you build The Relentless Storm, and a missed Arctic Assault is down 18s at rank 1.

edits.before: Your first bruiser item plus Relentless Storm keeps the lead; she builds pure tank and has no kill pressure, so you free-farm and win every extended trade.
edits.after: Your first bruiser item plus The Relentless Storm keeps the lead; she builds pure tank with no kill pressure, so free-farm and win every extended trade.

edits.before: R Stormbringer beats her Glacial Prison (R) in a straight all-in — leap her, land the slow, and your burst outpaces her Permafrost stun setup before she can proc it.
edits.after: R Stormbringer beats Glacial Prison (R) in a straight all-in — her bola is a 120s cooldown at rank 1, so once she throws it every walk-up for two minutes is free.

edits.before: Scale to teamfights where her engage matters
edits.after: Hold Frost Armor so your slows do nothing

notes: Fury of the North grants slow immunity while Frost Armor holds — Sky Splitter's and Stormbringer's slows simply do not apply to a Sejuani who has been out of combat. That is a genuine interaction absent from the whole entry; I placed it in wants.foe[2], the only in-band field available.
